name: Cafe-Konditorei Pernter
kurzbeschreibung: Café-Konditorei Pernter in Tirol Welcome to Café-Konditorei Pernter, a charming café and patisserie nestled in the heart of Tirol, where tradition meets exquisite taste.
beschreibung: The Cafe-Konditorei Pernter in Zillertal is a charming café that delights its guests with homemade cakes, exquisite coffee specialties, and a cozy atmosphere. It is a wonderful place to relax, read a good book, or chat with friends. The menu offers a fine selection of traditional Austrian pastries – from creamy Sachertorte and light apple strudel to tempting Topfenstrudel (curd cheese strudel). In addition, aromatic coffee specialties prepared with great care are served. The inviting interior with comfortable seating and charming details creates a feel-good atmosphere.
